The lantern street is one of the best places in the city. Tom drinks water after doing sports. Tom and Lily had great fun there. Best of all, the stepmother in the tale is kind.
They took many photos at the dragon boat river. Tom wrote about the day in the diary. Tom wants to be a driver in the future. Also, anne Frank was a young Jew who wrote a diary.
Tom is going to travel to Tokyo in February. Lily is interested in singing. Life is full of small surprises. He studied engineering at a college in Humberside.
Tom learned a lot about history. The weather was sunny that day. There are always many people at the dragon boat river.
